matrix = []

for i in range(N):
    row = []
    for j in range(M):
        row.append(int(input().strip()))
    matrix.append(row)

start_row = int(input().strip())
start_col = int(input().strip())


r, c = start_row, start_col
while True:
    current_height = matrix[r][c]
    best_r, best_c = r, c
    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
        nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
        if 0 <= nr < N and 0 <= nc < M:
            if matrix[nr][nc] > matrix[best_r][best_c]:
                best_r, best_c = nr, nc
    if (best_r, best_c) == (r, c):
        break
    else:
        r, c = best_r, best_c

final_height = matrix[r][c]

global_max = max(max(row) for row in matrix)

print(r, c)
print(final_height)
if final_height == global_max:
    print("Iced Americano, no sugar")
else:
    print("Hot Latte 300% sweetness")
